task.title: Creating a Strong Password
task.shortdesc: Creating a strong password that is long, unique and complex prevents cyber criminals from stealing your password and gaining access to sensitive information.

taskbody.context: When it comes to passwords, three rules matter more than everything else: length, uniqueness, and complexity. Follow these steps to create a strong password:

step.cmd: Make the password at least 16 characters long.
Compose a random mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.
Ensure that the password is unique to each account.

example.p:
Here are some samples of strong passwords that follow our principles:
VYffnxK9O$VuL59k
2kwe-85o5-LPFYz8
example.note: Do not use these examples as passwords! These should be a guide for creating your own unique passwords.
